description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, Kirk McCarley shares a powerful perspective on what it means to truly serve others.

When asked what the walls of his home would say, his answer was simple — it’s a place where people come to be welcomed, supported, and most importantly, heard.

He reflects on moments when we feel the need to speak, but instead, we’re called to listen with intention and humility.

It’s a reminder that sometimes the greatest impact we can make is simply being present and giving others the space to be heard.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, leadership insights, and real-life lessons.
